question: What is the meaning of social life cycle assessment (slca) in relation to chemical?
description: Social Life Cycle Assessment (SLCA) in relation to chemical focuses on analyzing the social and sociological aspects related to chemicals along their life cycle. This includes examining factors such as human rights, working conditions, governance, health, and safety in the context of chemical products. The assessment aims to evaluate the potential positive and negative impacts of chemicals on society throughout their life cycle.
